d: Watch as Firstpost covers the Third Russia-Africa Summit in Moscow, where Russian President Vladimir Putin welcomes delegations from 48 African nations, including 22 heads of state. Co-chaired alongside Burundian President and African Union Chair Evariste Ndayishimiye, the landmark summit signals a major geopolitical shift as Africa and Russia unite to challenge Western hegemony and forge a multipolar world order.
